title: BACnet — devices, points, requests, traces and logs
description: Everything bacnet-probe and the driver report over OTLP: device identity and health, every point, BACnet requests and packets, traces and logs. Filters at the top narrow every panel.

list.name: units
list.label: Units

query.query: label_values(bacnet_point_value{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind", bacnet_object_kind="analog"}, bacnet_units)

list.definition: label_values(bacnet_point_value{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind", bacnet_object_kind="analog"}, bacnet_units)

list.name: trace_id
list.label: Trace ID
list.description: Paste a trace ID (from a table below, or a log line's trace_id) to open it in the Trace panel

panels.title: Devices up
panels.description: Devices that answered their last read

targets.expr: sum(max by (bacnet_device_instance) (bacnet_device_up{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Devices down
panels.description: Discovered, but silent

targets.expr: count(max by (bacnet_device_instance) (bacnet_device_up{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"}) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Points
panels.description: Points with a present-value

targets.expr: count(max by (bacnet_device_instance, bacnet_object_type, bacnet_object_instance) (bacnet_point_value{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind"})) or vector(0)

sum(max by (bacnet_device_instance, bacnet_object_type, bacnet_object_instance) (bacnet_point_status{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind", bacnet_status_flag="in-alarm"})) or vector(0)

sum(max by (bacnet_device_instance, bacnet_object_type, bacnet_object_instance) (bacnet_point_status{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind", bacnet_status_flag="fault"})) or vector(0)

sum(max by (bacnet_device_instance, bacnet_object_type, bacnet_object_instance) (bacnet_point_status{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind", bacnet_status_flag="overridden"})) or vector(0)

sum(max by (bacnet_device_instance, bacnet_object_type, bacnet_object_instance) (bacnet_point_status{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind", bacnet_status_flag="out-of-service"})) or vector(0)

count(max by (bacnet_device_instance, bacnet_object_type, bacnet_object_instance) (bacnet_point_reachable{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind"}) == 0) or vector(0)
sum(rate(bacnet_client_requests_total{job=~"$job", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Request errors
panels.description: Refusals, timeouts, rejects and aborts, as a share of requests

targets.expr: 100 * sum(rate(bacnet_client_requests_total{job=~"$job", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_outcome!="ok"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(bacnet_client_requests_total{job=~"$job", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(bacnet_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
sum(rate(bacnet_cov_notifications_total{job=~"$job", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: Every device discovery found, with what it says about itself — the Devices pane

targets.expr: max by (bacnet_device_instance, bacnet_device_name, bacnet_vendor_name, bacnet_vendor_id, bacnet_device_model, bacnet_device_firmware, bacnet_device_software, bacnet_device_protocol_revision, bacnet_device_location, server_address, bacnet_network) (bacnet_device_up{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"})

max by (bacnet_device_instance) (bacnet_device_objects{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Device availability
panels.description: Up and down over time: a reboot or a cut cable is a red band

targets.expr: max by (bacnet_device_name, bacnet_device_instance) (bacnet_device_up{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Points

targets.expr: label_join(max by (bacnet_device_name, bacnet_device_instance, bacnet_object_type, bacnet_object_instance, bacnet_object_name, bacnet_object_kind, bacnet_units) (bacnet_point_value{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind"}), "point", "/", "bacnet_device_instance", "bacnet_object_type", "bacnet_object_instance")

max by (point) (label_join(bacnet_point_status{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind", bacnet_status_flag="in-alarm"}, "point", "/", "bacnet_device_instance", "bacnet_object_type", "bacnet_object_instance"))

max by (point) (label_join(bacnet_point_status{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind", bacnet_status_flag="fault"}, "point", "/", "bacnet_device_instance", "bacnet_object_type", "bacnet_object_instance"))

max by (point) (label_join(bacnet_point_status{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind", bacnet_status_flag="overridden"}, "point", "/", "bacnet_device_instance", "bacnet_object_type", "bacnet_object_instance"))

max by (point) (label_join(bacnet_point_status{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind", bacnet_status_flag="out-of-service"}, "point", "/", "bacnet_device_instance", "bacnet_object_type", "bacnet_object_instance"))

max by (point) (label_join(bacnet_point_reachable{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind"}, "point", "/", "bacnet_device_instance", "bacnet_object_type", "bacnet_object_instance"))

max by (point) (label_join(bacnet_point_event_state{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind"}, "point", "/", "bacnet_device_instance", "bacnet_object_type", "bacnet_object_instance"))

max by (point) (label_join(bacnet_point_reliability{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind"}, "point", "/", "bacnet_device_instance", "bacnet_object_type", "bacnet_object_instance"))

panels.description: Every point: present-value, status flags, event state and reliability — the Objects pane

panels.title: Analog points in $units
panels.description: Present-values over time, one panel per unit, so an axis never mixes kilograms with degrees

targets.expr: bacnet_point_value{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind", bacnet_object_kind="analog", bacnet_units=~"$units"}

panels.title: Binary and multi-state points
panels.description: A binary point's 0/1, a multi-state point's state number, over time

targets.expr: bacnet_point_value{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind", bacnet_object_kind=~"binary|multi-state"}

panels.title: Status flags set
panels.description: Only flags that were set during the range: in-alarm, fault, overridden, out-of-service

targets.expr: bacnet_point_status{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind"} == 1

bacnet_point_reachable{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind"}

bacnet_point_event_state{job=~"$job", bacnet_vendor_name=~"$vendor", bacnet_device_model=~"$model", bacnet_device_firmware=~"$firmware", bacnet_device_name=~"$device", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance", bacnet_object_kind=~"$kind"}
sum by (bacnet_service) (rate(bacnet_client_requests_total{job=~"$job", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests / s by outcome
panels.description: ok, error (a refusal), timeout, reject, abort, segmented

targets.expr: sum by (bacnet_outcome) (rate(bacnet_client_requests_total{job=~"$job", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Request latency
panels.description: From request to final reply or give-up, retries included

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, bacnet_service) (rate(bacnet_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, bacnet_service) (rate(bacnet_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, bacnet_service) (rate(bacnet_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
sum by (le) (increase(bacnet_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Packets / s
panels.description: Datagrams on the socket — the Packets tab

targets.expr: sum by (bacnet_direction) (rate(bacnet_client_packets_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (bacnet_direction) (rate(bacnet_client_bytes_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: COV notifications / s
panels.description: Change-of-value pushes received

targets.expr: sum by (bacnet_device_instance) (rate(bacnet_cov_notifications_total{job=~"$job", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests in range, by device, service and outcome

targets.expr: round(sum by (bacnet_device_instance, bacnet_service, bacnet_outcome) (increase(bacnet_client_requests_total{job=~"$job", bacnet_device_instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Recent traces
panels.description: Each scenario cycle, scan or call is one trace. Click a trace ID to open it

panels.title: Failed traces
panels.description: Traces with a span that ended in error: a refusal, a timeout

panels.title: Refused and failed BACnet requests
panels.description: Every request a device refused or did not answer, with what it was about and why

targets.query: {resource.service.name=~"${job:regex}" && name=~"bacnet.client.*" && status=error} | select(span.bacnet.device.instance, span.bacnet.object.type, span.bacnet.object.instance, span.bacnet.property.identifier, span.bacnet.error.code, span.bacnet.outcome)

panels.title: Slowest BACnet requests
panels.description: Requests over 50 ms: a slow trunk, or retries

targets.query: {resource.service.name=~"${job:regex}" && name=~"bacnet.client.*" && duration > 50ms} | select(span.bacnet.device.instance, span.bacnet.object.type, span.bacnet.property.identifier, span.bacnet.request.attempts)

panels.title: Trace ${trace_id}
panels.description: Set the Trace ID variable at the top to open a trace here, nested the way the work was done

panels.title: Log lines by level
panels.description: debug, info, warn and error, over time

targets.expr: sum by (detected_level) (count_over_time({service_name=~"${job:regex}"} [$__auto]))

panels.title: Logs
panels.description: Every line, filtered by level and by the device labels above — the Log tab. Each carries trace_id: open it in the Trace panel

targets.expr: {service_name=~"${job:regex}"} | detected_level=~"${level:regex}" | bacnet_device_firmware=~"${firmware:regex}" | bacnet_device_model=~"${model:regex}" | bacnet_vendor_name=~"${vendor:regex}"
{service_name=~"${job:regex}"} | detected_level=~"warn|error"
